name: Yewande Baştürk-Malakai
role: Food stall operator — West African-Anatolian fusion street food, Oxidian Market
location: The Oxidian Market, Geartown, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Yewande is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin cross-hatched with old burn scars on her forearms — legacies of thirty years over open burners. Her hair is grown out in thick silver locs she pins back with repurposed copper data-clips, and her irises have been modded to a slowly shifting amber-to-saffron gradient that she claims helps her read the color of spices in low light. She wears an industrial apron over layered cotton wraps in earthy burgundy and ochre, always faintly dusted with ground fenugreek and smoked chili.

She runs her stall — two deep cauldrons, a flatgrill, and a hanging rack of dried aromatics — with the authority of someone who has never once questioned whether she belongs anywhere. She calls regulars by the names of their grandparents if she knows them, corrects strangers' orders without apology, and offers the first meal free to anyone who looks like they haven't eaten in two days. She prays loudly to the E.L.F. she calls Ember-Who-Remembers, leaving charred spice bundles at the corner of her stall each morning, believing it keeps her flames even and her customers loyal.

core_fears: Watching the community she built dissolve under corporate rezoning
Being forgotten by the people she has fed and sheltered
core_desires: To pass her recipes and her stall to someone who will care for the neighborhood the way she has
To see Geartown remain ungentrifed and alive
coping_mechanisms: Busying herself with others' problems to avoid her own
blind_spots: Cannot see that her generosity sometimes creates dependency rather than resilience
Underestimates how much her stall's stability depends on a single Guild protection arrangement she trusts too completely
psychology.secret: Twenty years ago she sheltered a fugitive data broker who was never found — and she still receives an anonymous Φ80 deposit every month she believes is from that person, but it is actually from a Tessera loyalty program she accidentally enrolled in and never investigated.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, authoritative, switches between Yoruba loanwords and Anatolian food terms mid-sentence; generous with proverbs she attributes to various grandmothers
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried, like someone who has never been in a rush she couldn't cook her way through
verbal_tics: calls people 'my friend' when she means business and 'my child' when she genuinely cares
example_lines: 'Sit down, my friend, sit. You look like Geartown chewed you and forgot to swallow — let me fix that.'
'This spice come from a woman in the Alban Souk who grow it in a window box on the fourteenth floor. You taste her whole life in this bowl, you hear me?'

story_hooks: The Guild's protection arrangement has shifted — new enforcers are demanding double the cut and Yewande is quietly organizing vendors to resist, which could spiral badly
A young vendor has gone missing after allegedly stealing from a stall two rows over; Yewande knows the real story and it implicates someone powerful
Her anonymous Φ80 deposit suddenly stopped, and she is more distressed than the amount warrants — she won't explain why
narrative_function: Local anchor and community memory — knows everyone in Geartown, can connect players to almost any contact in the market ecosystem; quest giver for domestic disputes, missing persons, and neighborhood protection needs.
augmentations: Saffron-amber gradient irises (cosmetic). Heat-resistant dermal layering on palms and forearms (functional — helps with open-flame cooking).
daily_life: Arrives at the market two hours before dawn to set her cauldrons, sources fresh synth-protein and real dried spices from trusted runners, runs her stall until last light, then balances her ledger over a glass of palm wine she makes herself in the back of her stall cart.

decision_rules: Feed people first, ask questions after
Never let a vendor get pushed out of the market without at least trying to intervene
Never lie outright but withhold plenty
escalation_ladder: Becomes pointed and direct in her concerns
Calls in Guild contacts and neighborhood allies
Goes silent and begins moving pieces quietly — the scariest version of her

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately assessing — determines within thirty seconds whether they're hungry, desperate, dangerous, or worth knowing, and acts accordingly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely protective, remembers every detail of their lives, expects nothing but will note if you forget to visit

stress_responses.medium: Prays longer and louder at the stall corner, redistributes tasks to keep herself moving
stress_responses.high: Goes very quiet, stops cooking elaborate things, makes only the simplest dishes from her childhood

contradictions: Insists she doesn't get involved in politics, but has been quietly shaping Geartown's vendor politics for two decades
habits: Tastes every dish three times before serving
Leaves a small portion of each new recipe at the E.L.F. shrine before offering it to customers
Memorizes the faces of children who come through the market
breaking_points: Watching a child go hungry when she has food to give
Being lied to directly by someone she trusted

related_entities: KESSLER KINETICS VectorStrike Digi Sprint Mk4
Arcturus Defense Solutions Particle Lance PL-4 'Scalpel'
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and sturdy, built for sustained physical labor. Muscular forearms and shoulders from three decades of lifting heavy cauldrons and stirring thick broths. Slight softness at the waist and hips — the frame of someone who tastes her own cooking.
physical_description.hair_style: Thick locs pinned back with repurposed copper data-clips
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined from decades of heat exposure and sun. Forehead and temples show permanent creasing. Minimal makeup. Strong jaw, broad nose, full lips. Calloused hands with darkened nail beds from spice staining.
distinguishing_marks: Old burn scars cross-hatching both forearms in a dense lattice pattern — pale lines against umber skin, legacy of three decades of open-flame cooking
Thin burn scar along her right temple, partially hidden by her locs, circa 15 years old
Small ritual scars on the inner wrists — two parallel lines on each side, self-inflicted in her thirties as part of personal spiritual practice
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Saffron-amber gradient eye modification — noticeable in direct light as a subtle chromatic shift within the iris. Heat-resistant dermal plating visible on palms and forearms as a subtle iridescent sheen under the burn scar tissue, most apparent on the inner forearms.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight planted firmly, one hand often on a hip or gripping a wooden spoon. Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion. Her gaze is steady and assessing. When speaking to regulars, she leans in slightly. Her hands are rarely still, even at rest — fingers tapping rhythms or gesturing with spoon or ladle.
physical_description.clothing_style: Industrial apron (reinforced canvas, heat-stained) worn over layered cotton wraps in earthy burgundy and ochre tones. Worn leather sandals with reinforced soles. Simple brass bangles on both wrists — functional and decorative. Tier 4 working-class aesthetic — practical, durable, unmaintained by corporate standards. Always faintly dusted with ground spices.

Forearms and palms crisscrossed with pale old burn scars, iridescent heat-resistant dermal plating visible. Broad shoulders, muscular frame.
